+getdXXYY <- function(obj, ...) UseMethod("getdXXYY")
+
+getdXXYY.nlar.struct <- function(obj, ...) {
+ x <- obj$x
+ m <- obj$m
+ d <- obj$d
+ steps <- obj$steps
+ embedd(x, lags=c((0:(m-1))*(-d), steps) )
+}
+
+getdXX <- function(obj, ...)
+ diff(getdXXYY(obj,...))[ , 1:obj$m , drop=FALSE]
+
+getdYY <- function(obj, ...)
+ diff(getdXXYY(obj, ...))[ , obj$m+1]
+
+getdX1 <- function(obj, ...)
